questions.question: What is my favorite thing about you?
questions.response: YES! Everything about you is my favorite thing. I could never pick just one.
questions.wish: May your heart always know how deeply and completely you are loved.

questions.question: What do I think when I see you for the first time each day?
questions.response: Every single morning — I am the luckiest person in the entire world.
questions.wish: May every morning of your 21st year begin with joy and end with love.

questions.question: What nickname do I think suits you perfectly?
questions.response: All of the above — because you are my queen, my sunshine, and my everything.
questions.wish: May you always feel like the queen you truly are.

questions.question: How do I feel when you laugh?
options: Like I want to make you laugh forever
questions.response: Your laugh is the most beautiful sound in the world. I want to hear it forever.
questions.wish: May laughter fill every corner of your beautiful life.

questions.question: What is my favorite memory with you?
questions.response: I cannot pick just one — every moment with you is my favorite memory.
questions.wish: May we create a thousand more memories to treasure forever.
